components.title: Compute revenue per order
components.what: Calculate units × unit_price for each order and exclude cancelled ones.

components.title: Sum total and East revenue
components.what: Sum revenue for all non-cancelled orders and separately for East region orders.

components.title: Calculate percentage
components.what: Divide East revenue by total revenue and multiply by 100, rounding to one decimal.

log.author: B
log.draft:
Excluding cancelled orders ORD-1406 and ORD-1865:

East revenue = (13 × 109.19) + (36 × 105.11) = 1,419.47 + 3,783.96 = 5,203.43.

Total non-cancelled revenue = 20,663.93.

East percentage = (5,203.43 ÷ 20,663.93) × 100 = 25.1812%, which rounds to 25.2%.

FINAL: 25.2

challenges.problem: ORD-1523 is marked 'pending', not cancelled, so it should be included. However, the draft's total non-cancelled revenue of 20,663.93 needs verification against all non-cancelled rows. If the draft accidentally excluded pending orders too, the total would be wrong.

East region non-cancelled orders are ORD-1225 and ORD-1823 only. The draft's calculation (13×109.19) + (36×105.11) is correct. However, if there were any East pending orders, they would need inclusion. There are none, so this is fine.
5203.43 / 20663.93 = 0.251811... × 100 = 25.1811%. Rounding to one decimal place gives 25.2%. This is correct.

asked: The record notes that the total of 20,663.93 still needs an explicit row-by-row verification. Please map each of the 12 addends in your total to its order_id, and confirm that 12 is exactly 14 rows minus the 2 cancelled rows (ORD-1406, ORD-1865) with no row counted twice or omitted.

Does the result change if revenue per row is computed at full precision and rounded only at the end, versus rounding each row's revenue to cents first? State the unrounded ratio to at least 4 decimal places and confirm the one-decimal rounding is not on a boundary.
replies: Because units are integers and unit_price values have at most two decimal places, multiplying units × unit_price produces exact cent values with no fractional cents to round (e.g., 21 × 88.83 = 1865.43 exactly). Thus full precision per row is identical to cent rounding. The unrounded East share ratio is 5,203.43 / 20,663.93 = 0.25181222... (25.1812%). To one decimal place, rounding 25.1812% yields 25.2%, well clear of any rounding boundary (the boundary to round to 25.1% is 25.15%, and to 25.3% is 25.25%).
